notes: Givaudan Flavors Corporation is the US flavours arm of Givaudan SA, whose corporate headquarters is Givaudan International SA in Vernier, Switzerland; group headcount is about 17,580. JobsOhio's December 2024 report ties the $3,000,000 Economic Development Grant commitment to a $127,250,000 Hamilton County project with 882 jobs retained and 220 created (https://www.jobsohio.com/files/reports/2024_annual_monthly_metrics.pdf).

Private Cincinnati medical-device maker (on-body drug infusion), operating in Evendale, West Chester and Franklin since 2010; JobsOhio's February 2023 report lists 193 jobs retained and 257 committed against a $124,000,000 investment, so several hundred employees at most. The LLC is the grant payee of Enable Injections, Inc.; no outside corporate owner was found, though it is venture-backed.

NP DWBA LLC is a single-purpose vehicle of NorthPoint Development, the Kansas City industrial developer building the First Flight Commerce Center next to the Dayton-Wright Brothers Airport (DWBA) in Miami Township, a $146,000,000 project begun in April 2024 (https://www.wdtn.com/news/local-news/new-146-million-commerce-center-begins-development-in-miami-township/); JobsOhio's own reports show NorthPoint Holdings spec-development (OSIP) grants in Montgomery, Butler and Lucas counties. NorthPoint publishes no headcount, so the bucket is a guess for a developer operating in 28 states.

JobsOhio's release calls Jamon Sellman a local Urbana developer; Sellman Enterprises LLC renovated the historic Willman Furniture building on Monument Square into nine loft apartments and the WillWork coworking space, the project behind the $800,000 Vibrant Community Grant recorded in October 2023 for Champaign County. Its business is owning and leasing the building, not operating in it.

GXO Logistics Supply Chain, Inc. is the US operating subsidiary of GXO Logistics, Inc. (NYSE: GXO), headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut; the FY2024 10-K reports about 152,000 team members in 27 countries as of December 31, 2024. The grant matches a $35,600,000 Madison County warehouse with 200 jobs committed (JobsOhio, February 2024).

Off-price department store chain headquartered at 55 Scott Avenue, Morgantown, West Virginia, with more than 116 stores at the time of the grant and about 8,000 employees in 2023; Warburg Pincus has held the majority stake since 2016, with the Gabriel family retaining a minority. The money funded its 850,000 sq ft Springfield distribution center, so this is an operating retailer building its own facility.

Luvata's own site states that Mitsubishi Materials Corporation acquired Luvata in May 2017 and that Luvata is a group company of MMC, which reported 18,323 consolidated employees as of March 31, 2024; MMC is headquartered in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. Luvata Ohio runs the Delaware, Ohio copper plant behind a $12,000,000 project with 111 jobs retained (JobsOhio, March 2024).

The recipient address, 444 Salomon Circle in Sparks, Nevada, is SNC's own headquarters, so the payee is the parent; SNC is owned by Fatih and Eren Ozmen and is described as having over 4,000 employees, with one infobox figure of 5,000 for 2022, which leaves it near the 5,000 line after the 2021 Sierra Space spin-off. The grants fund its aircraft maintenance and overhaul build-out at Dayton International Airport.

Victoriaville & Co., founded 1907 in Victoriaville, Quebec, is a fourth-generation family casket maker that says it employs hundreds of people in Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom, and is the third-largest hardwood casket manufacturer. Its US manufacturing entity opened a Cleveland plant in 2023, a $1,162,000 project with 100 jobs committed (JobsOhio, April 2023).
